segments.name: Payment services
segments.description: Provides payment solutions to business and individual customers, including payment gateway services and payout services for cross-border transactions.
segments.evidence: Payment service mainly provides payment solutions to customers, including payment gateway services and payout services.

segments.name: Hospitality-related software services
segments.description: Sells subscriptions to the OwlNest property management system, which hospitality businesses use for inventory management and bookings.
segments.evidence: The Company has five reportable segments: Payment services, Hospitality-related software services, Hospitality-related platform services, E-commerce platform, and Other.

segments.name: Hospitality-related platform services
segments.description: Operates the group's hospitality platform services, alongside its hospitality software services, for hospitality businesses.
segments.evidence: The Company has five reportable segments: Payment services, Hospitality-related software services, Hospitality-related platform services, E-commerce platform, and Other.

segments.name: E-commerce platform
segments.description: Operates the group's e-commerce platform and related services for businesses and consumers.
segments.evidence: The Company has five reportable segments: Payment services, Hospitality-related software services, Hospitality-related platform services, E-commerce platform, and Other.

segments.name: Other
segments.description: Holds other services, mainly small-scale blockchain services projects conducted in collaboration with the Taiwan government.
segments.evidence: Revenues from other services primarily consist of transactions related to small-scale OwlTing Blockchain Services projects conducted in collaboration with the Taiwan government.

revenueModel.text: Businesses and individuals involved in cross-border commercial activity pay the company for payment, hospitality and e-commerce services.
revenueModel.evidence: We provide solutions across three main business segments: payments, hospitality, and e-commerce, serving businesses and individuals whose commercial activities involve cross-border transactions.
